public_rationale: He says that outside NVIDIA and Turing there 'doesn't appear to be' one profitable company 'in the industry'. 'Doesn't appear' is a hedge about how things look to him. 'The industry' is not defined. If it means AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic, the evidence fits his view, since both were losing money. If it includes Microsoft, Google, or chip suppliers, it plainly does not. The result depends entirely on a boundary he did not draw. An earlier review found that turning this hedged remark into a flat test was unfair to him. So the claim is not graded.
limitations: Under a narrow reading (pure-play AI labs only), the main labs were losing money in early 2025, which is consistent with his remark.
